name: Southern Palladium Limited
source: Southern Palladium Limited financial report for the year ended 30 June 2026 (audited, BDO Audit Pty Ltd unmodified opinion), consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, JSE cloudlink YE26, results announcement 28 September 2026; figures in AUD. Interest income is the Group's only income line and, as for the FY2025 column, it is carried in Net Finance Costs with income shown as a negative number (-1,559,596). Operating Expenses 12,025,822 is administration 1,843,477 plus employee benefits 648,556 plus share-based payment 513,702 plus share of loss of associate 292,132 plus impairment of loan receivable 8,727,955. Operating Profit (EBIT) is interest income 1,559,596 less those expenses = -10,466,226, which is the statement's loss before income tax; income tax is nil, so Net Profit is -10,466,226. EPS is the basic and diluted loss per share of A$0.089. The FY2025 Operating Expenses and EBIT cells, previously withheld because no filing settled the twin SDL/SDL.JO keys, are now taken from the FY2025 comparative column of this audited report. | CRON 20261025_155306: period columns and blank cells synchronised between the SDL and SDL.JO keys from whichever of the two already held the verified figures (same company name and currency, no value overwritten where the two disagreed); no new figure was collected in this step.

Expenses exclude the share of loss of associate (727,671), the same convention the FY2024 and FY2023 columns of this file follow: 1,042,940 - 5,094,757 - 727,671 = (4,779,488) printed loss before tax. FY2023 net finance costs from the consolidated statement of profit or loss for the year ended 30 June 2023 (audited), page 27: interest income 324,706, no finance costs. FY2022: interest income printed as nil, no finance costs. Unit A$.
